quantitative_overrides.fin_note: Entrenched credit rating duopoly and enterprise financial risk analytics platform with an unassailable 30-year regulatory toll booth (NRSRO). Tangible ROIC normalized to 35.0% cap neutralizing accumulated acquisition goodwill from Bureau van Dijk and RMS. Net debt of $4.6B is 1.87x NI with >14x interest coverage, supported by recurring ARR (>60% of Moody's Analytics) and asset-light FCF conversion (95%). Peak Owner EPS of $14.52 in FY2025 represents a clean new cycle high following the 2022-2023 rate hiking shock. 5-10Y through-the-cycle growth of 9.0% is driven by 3.5% debt issuance refinancing volumes, 2.0% rating price/complexity capture, 2.5% analytics workflow expansion, and 1.0% net share repurchases.
